title: X of a Kind in a Deck of Cards
summary: Given an integer array where each element represents the value on a card, determine if it is possible to partition the cards into one or more groups such that each group contains exactly two or more cards with the same value.
statement: Given an integer array where each element represents the value on a card, determine if it is possible to partition the cards into one or more groups such that each group contains exactly two or more cards with the same value. Return true if such a partition is possible, otherwise return false.
constraints: Partition the entire deck into groups of equal size at least two.
Every group must contain one repeated card value.
known_wrong_solutions:
def has_equal_card_groups(deck):
 from math import gcd
 from collections import Counter
 size=0
 for count in Counter(deck).values():size=gcd(size,count)
 return min(Counter(deck).values())>=2
def has_equal_card_groups(deck):
 from math import gcd
 from collections import Counter
 size=0
 for count in Counter(deck).values():size=count
 return size>=2
hints: A valid group size must divide every value frequency.
Compute the greatest common divisor of all counts.
Return whether that gcd is at least two.
Every common divisor creates equal pure groups, and any valid size is such a divisor.
editorial: Every common divisor creates equal pure groups, and any valid size is such a divisor.

tests.explanation: Each value can form a pair.
Counts 3,3,2 have greatest common divisor one.
